description: Synthetic, de-identified rejection-feedback samples used for human quality evaluation of the refinement prompt. No production feedback may be added to this file. Expectations describe what a reviewer must verify; they are not byte-matched in CI.

samples.feedback: This request is missing an exclusion for contractors. Please add an exclusion source for contractor accounts and resubmit.
samples.expectation: Minimal changes only. No restructuring, no added guidance.

samples.feedback: The justification is not sufficient. The justification you provided is really not sufficient at all. Basically the justification needs a lot more detail, so please provide a lot more detail in the justification.
